C++ is a compiled systems language. Used for games, engines, externals, OS tools. Standard: isocpp.org.

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation): text data format with objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null.
HTTP: protocol for web requests. Methods GET/POST/etc. HTTPS is HTTP over TLS.

UNC: Unified Naming Convention for Roblox executor APIs so scripts are more portable.

JavaScript es el lenguaje de los navegadores y Node.js. Base del frontend web.
